title: Introduce on-demand tail sampler and cost-regression hysteresis
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: Long-tail token-cost and token-latency regressions generate noisy alerts and high investigation overhead. We need a low-cost, on-demand mechanism to capture high-fidelity token-level traces for the tail of invocations and a hysteresis policy layer for cost-regression alerts to avoid flapping during transient spikes.

What this PR does: Adds an on-demand tail sampler (sampling triggered by alerts, manual query, or synthetic probe) that captures compact token snapshots + invocation metadata; introduces an alert hysteresis adapter that requires sustained deviation before promotion to high-severity; ships a new Grafana dashboard with tail-sampled invocation panels and a compact cost-regression timeline; and exposes a small sampling API for troubleshooting teams.

Scope checklist:
- [x] Implement on-demand tail sampler service and API endpoint (telemetry/service/tail_sampler.py)
- [x] Add compact token snapshot proto and storage adapter (telemetry/models/token_snapshot.proto, telemetry/storage/snapshot_store.go)
- [x] Integrate sampler with alerting to allow automatic capture on low-severity token-cost alerts
- [x] Implement cost-regression hysteresis policy in alerting backend (alerts/hysteresis_adapter.py)
- [x] Add Grafana dashboard JSON and a README for interpreting tail samples (dashboards/tail-sampler.json, dashboards/README_tail_sampler.md)
- [x] Add unit and integration tests for sampler and hysteresis logic (telemetry/tests/*)
- [x] Add lightweight sampling quota checks and tenant-scoped limits to prevent runaway storage

Notes and constraints: Tail samples are compact by design (only first/last n tokens, token-cost deltas, top-5 KV misses). Samples are tenant-scoped and retention defaults to 7 days. The sampling API is authenticated and rate-limited. This PR intentionally keeps payload sizes small to make on-demand sampling feasible for high-traffic tenants.

Related items: ENG-5473 has the original design doc; SUP-2217 is a customer incident that motivated the hysteresis behavior.

High-level commit summary: see commits field for per-commit blurbs.

Behavioral expectations after merge:
- New low-severity token-cost alerts will, by default, elicit an on-demand tail sample (configurable per alert rule).
- Alert severity escalation to P1 requires hysteresis window of sustained deviation (configurable via alert policy).
- Observability teams can request immediate samples via console or API for active investigations.

review_comments: Priya Nair: Nice approach to make samples compact. Two asks: (1) can we include a tenant privacy review note? (2) ensure the snapshot proto explicitly marks PII fields for redaction.
Avery Chen (author): Added README section about PII handling and redaction markers in token_snapshot.proto; added a privacy checklist to the runbook.
Lucas Romero: Hysteresis adapter looks good but please add a backfill guard — don't suppress alerts for already open incidents. Also add telemetry for hysteresis decisions.
Avery Chen: Added hysteresis decision metric (alerts.hysteresis_decision{action=promote|hold}) and a guard that ignores currently acknowledged incidents when computing sustained deviation.
Emilia Park: Request to add a dashboard panel that correlates sampling frequency with storage consumption so ops can tune tenant defaults.
Avery Chen: Added panel and a lightweight alert on sampling.storage_utilization > 75% for tenant-scoped buckets.
release_notes: Introduces an on-demand tail sampler for compact invocation snapshots and an alert hysteresis adapter to reduce alert churn for transient token-cost/latency spikes. New Grafana dashboard and runbook included. Configurable tenant limits and PII redaction markers added.
operational_runbook: Added dashboards/README_tail_sampler.md with troubleshooting steps: how to request on-demand samples, interpret token_snapshot fields, adjust tenant limits, and revert hysteresis policy for a specific rule.
security_notes: Snapshots mark sensitive fields for redaction; sampling API requires tenant-scoped auth and rate limits. Security scan cleared for this change.
manual_steps_after_merge: Migrate existing low-severity alert rules to include on-demand sampling=enabled by default. Ops team to validate tenant quotas via the new dashboard; run runbook verify-sample-flow checklist.
notes_for_release: Feature is opt-in for enterprise tenants via account settings; default: enabled for platform internal teams. Inform SRE and Solutions Eng of the new sampling console option.
